stem: Farrow Robotics wants a validation that only ever produces a warning and never stops `terraform apply`, even when the condition it tests turns out false. Which mechanism fits, and what is its minimum Terraform version?

choices.text: a `precondition` block, available from Terraform 1.5 onward
a `check` block, available only from Terraform 1.5 onward
a `check` block, available from Terraform 1.2 onward
a variable `validation` block, available from Terraform 1.5 onward

rationale: check blocks are the one mechanism that only ever warns and lets the run continue, and they need Terraform 1.5 or later. A precondition halts the run with an error on failure -- the opposite of what's wanted -- and its own version floor is 1.2, not 1.5. Pairing the right mechanism (check) with the wrong version (1.2) is still wrong, because check blocks specifically need the newer 1.5 floor. A variable validation block also halts the run on failure rather than just warning, so it doesn't fit either, regardless of the version stated.
